summary: Exhaustive GO-LIVE manual test pack for the Inventory module of Saranam India Health Care (https://saranam.fieldintel.ai). Covers the Inventory Dashboard, Medicines Master, Stock Management, Purchase Orders (list/wizard/detail), Dispensing (list/wizard/dashboard/detail), Alerts (list/dashboard), and Provider Stock. Includes functional, UI/UX, validation, negative, API, permission, edge-case and data-integrity cases. Endpoints, payloads and behaviours were derived strictly from frontend/src/api/inventory.js, frontend/src/api/client.js, backend/app/inventory/routes.py and backend/app/inventory/schemas.py. Several front-end vs back-end payload mismatches were found during analysis and are captured as defect-hunting cases (e.g. PO Wizard sends items[].ordered_quantity but a top-level status:'draft', Goods Receipt dialog sends {items:[...]} while backend GoodsReceiveSchema expects {received_items:[...]} with mrp & date validation, Dispensing Wizard posts {items:[{batches}]} while DispenseCreateSchema expects a single medicine_id/dispensed_quantity/dispensed_from_location, AssignStock sends source_location_id while backend expects from_location_id, ReturnStock sends destination_location_id while backend expects to_location_id).
in_scope: Inventory Dashboard KPIs, quick actions, module cards, refresh, loading/empty states
Medicines Master: list, search, pagination, add/edit/deactivate medicine, all form fields and validation
Stock Management: stock list, location filter, status filter, pagination, stock-level bar, value, category, status chips
Purchase Orders: list, status filter, client-side search, pagination, 3-step creation wizard, PO detail, submit/approve/receive/print, goods receipt with batch details
Dispensing: records list with type/date filters and search, 4-step dispensing wizard (patient/prescription/batch/review), dispensing dashboard KPIs, dispensing detail with medicine return
Alerts: alert list with type/severity/status tabs, acknowledge, resolve, bulk acknowledge, alerts dashboard with breakdown
Provider Stock: provider locations list, setup provider, assign stock, return stock, expand provider to view stock
Cross-cutting selectors: SupplierSelector, LocationSelector, PatientSelector, PrescriptionSelector, QuickDispenseSelector, BatchSelector (FIFO/FEFO)
Role-based access (admin/data_entry/viewer), 401 session handling, non-existent ids
API request/response/error verification for all inventory endpoints used by the UI
out_of_scope: Requisitions module (no UI route wired in App.jsx; backend endpoints exist but are not exercised by the Inventory screens)
Analytics deep reports (ABC-VED, consumption, turnover) beyond the dashboard/KPI consumption already wired to UI
Stock-movements list screen (no dedicated route in App.jsx)
Immediate-dispense endpoints (consumed by Saranam visit flow, not by the Inventory screens under test)
Suppliers CRUD screen and Locations CRUD screen (no dedicated routes; only consumed via selectors)
Login/authentication module internals (covered by the Auth test pack); only session expiry behaviour is verified here
roles_and_access: All Inventory routes require an authenticated session (JWT access_token in localStorage; Authorization: Bearer header added by the axios client). Backend RBAC (role_required decorator) maps roles to permissions: admin = {read, write, approve, dispense, manage}; data_entry = {read, write, dispense}; viewer = {read}. Read endpoints (lists, dashboards, detail GETs) need 'read'. Create/edit medicine, create/update/submit PO, create supplier, transfer stock, acknowledge/resolve alerts, provider-stock assign/return/setup need 'write'. Delete medicine, delete location/supplier, manual stock update (/stock/update), generate alerts need 'manage'. Approve/cancel PO and approve/reject requisition need 'approve'. Dispense and return-dispensed need 'dispense'. Missing/invalid token returns 401 (client attempts refresh then redirects to /login). A logged-in user lacking the required permission receives HTTP 403 with message 'Insufficient permissions. Required: ...'. Unknown user id on a valid token returns 401 'User not found'.

api_endpoints.purpose: List medicines with page, per_page, search, category, essential, is_active; returns {medicines,total,page,per_page,pages}
Get a single medicine by id (404 if not found)
Type-ahead search medicines by q (limit max 100)
Create medicine (write); 201 success, 422 validation, 400 ValueError (e.g. duplicate)
Update medicine (write); 422 validation, 404 if not found
Deactivate medicine (manage); 404 if not found
List inventory locations (filter type, is_active)
List stock levels (location_id, medicine_id, status, low_stock) - returns a flat array
List low-stock items
Manual stock update (manage); StockUpdateSchema requires medicine_id, location_id, quantity>=0
Transfer stock between locations (write); 201 success, 400 ValueError
List suppliers (page, per_page, is_active); returns {suppliers,total,...}
List batches (medicine_id, location_id, status, expiring_soon); BatchSelector reads response.data.batches
List batches expiring within ?days (default 30)
List POs (page, per_page, status, supplier_id); returns {purchase_orders,total,page,per_page,pages}
Get PO detail (404 if not found)
Create PO (write); PurchaseOrderCreateSchema requires supplier_id + items[>=1] each {medicine_id, ordered_quantity>0, unit_price>=0}; 422 validation
Update a draft PO (write)
Submit PO for approval (write)
Approve PO (approve permission)
Record goods receipt (write); GoodsReceiveSchema expects {received_items:[{item_id, received_quantity>0, batch_number, manufacture_date, expiry_date>mfg, mrp?}]}
Cancel PO (approve); body {reason}
Aggregate patient prescriptions from OPD + Saranam plan-of-care (UUID patient_id); 500 on error
List dispensing records (page, per_page, patient_id, medicine_id); returns {dispensing_records,total,page,per_page,pages}
Process dispensing (dispense permission); DispenseCreateSchema requires patient_id, medicine_id, dispensed_quantity>0, dispensed_from_location
Validate prescription (dispense)
Check availability (read); requires medicine_id, location_id, quantity>0 else 400
Get dispensing record by id (404 if not found)
Return dispensed medicine (dispense); body {item_id, return_quantity, reason}
Get a patient's dispensing history
List stock alerts (type, status default active, severity); returns array (UI reads response.data.alerts)
Run all alert checks (manage)
Acknowledge alert (write); 404 if not found
Resolve alert (write); body {notes/resolution_notes}; 404 if not found
Inventory turnover/KPIs (read); used by Dispensing Dashboard stat cards
Dashboard stats (read)
List provider stock locations with summary (read)
Get a provider's stock items (read)
Create a provider stock location (write); 400 ValueError
Assign stock to provider (write); backend reads medicine_id, quantity, from_location_id (KeyError -> 400)
Return stock from provider (write); backend reads medicine_id, quantity, to_location_id (KeyError -> 400)

test_data_setup: At least 3 user accounts mapped to backend roles: an 'admin' (all permissions), a 'data_entry' user (read+write+dispense, NO approve/manage), and a 'viewer' user (read-only). Confirm each can log in to https://saranam.fieldintel.ai.

Master medicines seeded, e.g. Paracetamol 500mg Tablet (generic Acetaminophen, brand Crocin, GST 12%, HSN 30049099), Amoxicillin 500mg Capsule, Morphine 10mg Injection (Schedule X / narcotic), ORS Sachet. Note one medicine name for duplicate testing.
At least 2 active inventory locations of non-provider type, e.g. 'Central Store' (central_store) and 'Saranam Pharmacy' (pharmacy), each with stock on hand.
At least 2 active suppliers, one flagged preferred with a rating and delivery_lead_days, e.g. 'MedPlus Distributors' and 'Apollo Pharmacy Supplies', GST/PAN populated.

Stock with batches across statuses: an OPTIMAL item, a LOW item, a CRITICAL/out-of-stock item, an OVERSTOCKED item; batches with varying expiry: one expired (past), one near-expiry (<30 days, e.g. 2026-06-20), one mid (<90 days), one healthy (>90 days). Use realistic batch numbers e.g. BATCH-PCM-2401, AMX-2403, MOR-2312.
At least one PO in each status: draft, pending_approval, approved, partial_received, received, cancelled (create as needed). Capture their ids and po_number values.

A Saranam/OPD patient with at least one active prescription / plan-of-care containing medications with pending quantities (for the prescription dispensing path), plus a patient with NO prescriptions (empty-state path). Capture patient ids (UUID).
At least one existing dispensing record (with at least one returnable item) to exercise the detail/return flow; capture its id.
At least one active alert per type if possible (low_stock, out_of_stock, near_expiry, expired) in active/acknowledged/resolved states; otherwise run POST /alerts/generate as admin to populate.
At least one provider already set up under Provider Stock with some assigned stock, plus a valid provider UUID to use for the 'Setup New Provider' flow.
Browser DevTools (Network + Console) available for API verification; a spare invalid/expired token to simulate 401.

test_cases.title: Inventory Dashboard loads with all six KPI stat cards
test_cases.preconditions: Logged in as admin; seed data present.
steps: Navigate to /inventory.
Observe the spinner 'Loading inventory...' then the loaded dashboard.
Verify the six stat cards render: Total Medicines, Stock Locations, Total Stock Value, Low Stock Items, Expiring Soon, Active Suppliers.
test_cases.expected_result: All six cards render with numeric values. Total Stock Value is formatted with ₹ and Indian grouping. Values are derived from getMedicines, getLocations, getStock, getSuppliers, getBatches calls.

test_cases.title: Dashboard low-stock and expiring-soon alert styling
test_cases.preconditions: Seed data has at least one LOW/CRITICAL stock item and at least one batch expiring within 90 days.
steps: Open /inventory.
Inspect the 'Low Stock Items' and 'Expiring Soon' cards.
test_cases.expected_result: When value > 0 the card shows a red ring (ring-2 ring-red-200) and a pulsing red dot. Low Stock counts items with stock_status StockStatus.LOW or StockStatus.CRITICAL; Expiring Soon counts batches with days_to_expiry between 1 and 89.

test_cases.title: Dashboard stat-card links navigate to correct screens
test_cases.preconditions: Logged in as admin.
steps: On /inventory click 'Total Medicines' card -> expect /inventory/medicines.
Back. Click 'Stock Locations', 'Total Stock Value', 'Low Stock Items', 'Expiring Soon' -> each routes to /inventory/stock.
Back. Click 'Active Suppliers' -> expect /inventory/purchase-orders.
test_cases.expected_result: Each card navigates to its configured href without error.

test_cases.title: Quick Actions and Module cards navigation
test_cases.preconditions: Logged in as admin.
steps: Click Quick Action 'New Medicine' -> /inventory/medicines.
Click 'Purchase Order' -> /inventory/purchase-orders/new.
Click 'Dispense' -> /inventory/dispense.
Click 'Stock Report' -> /inventory/stock.
Click each of the 4 Module cards and confirm correct route.
test_cases.expected_result: All Quick Action and Module links route correctly.

test_cases.title: Dashboard Refresh button re-fetches stats
test_cases.preconditions: Logged in as admin; DevTools Network open.
steps: Open /inventory.
Click the Refresh (circular arrow) button top-right.
Watch the Network tab.
test_cases.expected_result: The five parallel GET calls fire again and the cards re-render with current data; brief loading spinner is acceptable.

test_cases.title: Dashboard resilient when an underlying API errors
test_cases.preconditions: Ability to force a 500 on one of the dashboard calls (e.g. block /inventory/batches in DevTools).
steps: Block or fail one of the five dashboard requests.
Reload /inventory.
test_cases.expected_result: Because all five are awaited in a single Promise.all, a single failure causes the catch branch: stats stay at defaults (zeros) and an error is logged to console; the page still renders without crashing (no white screen).

test_cases.title: Medicines list loads with header count and table columns
test_cases.preconditions: Logged in as admin; medicines seeded.
steps: Navigate to /inventory/medicines.
Verify header shows 'Medicine Master' and a subtitle '<total> medicines'.
Verify columns: Code, Medicine Name, Generic, Brand, Strength, Form, Category, Status, Actions.
test_cases.expected_result: Table lists medicines (25 per page). Form badge strips the 'DosageForm.' prefix. Status shows 'Essential' or 'Non-Essential'. Subtitle equals API total.

test_cases.title: Medicine search filters list and resets to page 1
test_cases.preconditions: At least 2 distinct medicines seeded.
steps: On /inventory/medicines navigate to page 2 (if available).
Type 'Paracetamol' into the search box.
Observe the table and watch Network.
test_cases.expected_result: On each keystroke the list re-fetches with search=Paracetamol and page resets to 1; only matching medicines show.

test_cases.title: Medicines empty state when no match found
test_cases.preconditions: Logged in as admin.
steps: Search for a string that matches nothing, e.g. 'zzzznomatch'.
Wait for the result.
test_cases.expected_result: Table body shows the centered Pill icon with 'No medicines found'. Pagination is hidden.

test_cases.title: Medicines pagination Prev/Next behaviour
test_cases.preconditions: More than 25 medicines exist (total > 25).
steps: Open /inventory/medicines.
Confirm 'Page 1 of N (total)' footer is shown and Prev is disabled.
Click Next; confirm page increments and data changes.
On the last page confirm Next is disabled.
test_cases.expected_result: Prev disabled on page 1; Next disabled on last page; page label and totals are accurate; totalPages = ceil(total/25).

test_cases.title: Add Medicine dialog opens with default form values
test_cases.preconditions: Logged in as admin.
steps: Click 'Add Medicine'.
Inspect the dialog field defaults.
test_cases.expected_result: Dialog titled 'Add New Medicine' opens; defaults: dosage_form Tablet, unit Tablets, pack_size 10, drug schedule H, NLEM P, storage Room Temperature (15-25°C), GST 12, Generic and Essential checked. Required markers (*) on Medicine Name and Generic Name.

test_cases.title: Create medicine with all valid fields
test_cases.preconditions: Logged in as admin (write permission).
steps: Open Add Medicine dialog.

Fill: Medicine Name 'Amoxicillin', Generic 'Amoxicillin', Brand 'Mox', Manufacturer 'Cipla', Dosage Form Capsule, Strength '500mg', Unit 'Capsules', Pack Size 10, Category 'Antibiotics', Schedule H, HSN '30049099', GST 12, Storage Room Temperature.
Click Create.
test_cases.expected_result: POST returns 201; dialog closes; green success banner 'Medicine created' (auto-hides after 3s); list refreshes and shows the new medicine with an auto-generated code.

test_cases.title: Create medicine blocked when required names missing (client validation)
test_cases.preconditions: Logged in as admin.
steps: Open Add Medicine dialog.
Leave Medicine Name and Generic Name blank, fill other fields.
Click Create.
test_cases.test_data: Medicine Name = blank, Generic Name = blank
test_cases.expected_result: Inline red banner 'Medicine name and generic name are required'; no POST request is sent; dialog stays open.

test_cases.title: Create medicine - server validation (422) on over-length / invalid values
test_cases.preconditions: Logged in as admin; use DevTools to inspect response.
steps: Open Add Medicine dialog.
Enter a Medicine Name longer than 200 characters and a GST % of 250.
Click Create.
test_cases.expected_result: Backend returns 422 with {message:'Validation error', errors:{...}} (Length max 200 / Range max 100). UI shows the server message text in the red banner; record not created.

test_cases.title: Create duplicate medicine returns 400 ValueError
test_cases.preconditions: A medicine with a known name/code already exists.
steps: Open Add Medicine dialog.
Enter the same identifying details as an existing medicine.
Click Create.
test_cases.test_data: Duplicate of an existing seeded medicine
test_cases.expected_result: If the service raises ValueError for duplicate, backend returns 400 with a message; UI shows that message in the red banner and does not add a duplicate row.

test_cases.title: Edit existing medicine pre-populates form and updates
test_cases.preconditions: At least one medicine exists; logged in as admin.
steps: Click the pencil (Edit) icon on a medicine row.
Confirm dialog title 'Edit Medicine' and pre-filled values (drug_class and dosage_form have prefixes stripped/lowercased).
Change Strength to '650mg' and toggle Essential off.
Click Update.
test_cases.expected_result: PUT returns 200; success banner 'Medicine updated'; list reflects the new strength and Non-Essential status.

test_cases.title: Delete (deactivate) medicine with confirmation
test_cases.preconditions: Logged in as admin (manage permission required for delete).
steps: Click the trash (Delete) icon on a medicine row.
Confirm the browser confirm dialog 'Delete this medicine?'.
Observe the list.
test_cases.expected_result: DELETE returns 200 'Medicine deactivated successfully'; success banner 'Deleted'; the medicine drops out of the active list (deactivated, not hard-deleted).

test_cases.title: Cancel delete confirmation keeps medicine
test_cases.preconditions: Logged in as admin.
steps: Click the trash icon on a medicine row.
Click Cancel on the confirm dialog.
test_cases.expected_result: No DELETE request is sent; medicine remains in the list.

test_cases.title: Add/Edit dialog dismissal via overlay, X and Cancel
test_cases.preconditions: Logged in as admin.
steps: Open Add Medicine; click the dark overlay outside the card -> dialog closes.
Re-open; click the X icon -> closes.
Re-open; click Cancel -> closes. Confirm clicks inside the card do NOT close it.
test_cases.expected_result: Dialog closes on overlay/X/Cancel and form resets to defaults; clicking inside the card does not close it (stopPropagation).

test_cases.title: Pack Size / GST numeric coercion in form
test_cases.preconditions: Logged in as admin.
steps: Open Add Medicine; clear Pack Size and type letters; clear GST and type letters.
Observe field values.
test_cases.expected_result: Non-numeric input resolves to 0 (parseInt/parseFloat fallback). Pack Size of 0 will later fail backend Range(min=1) returning 422 if submitted.

test_cases.title: Viewer role cannot create/edit/delete medicines (403)
test_cases.preconditions: Logged in as the viewer (read-only) user.
steps: Open /inventory/medicines (should load).
Open Add Medicine and attempt to Create a valid medicine; watch the API response.
Attempt Edit and Delete on a row.
test_cases.expected_result: List GET succeeds (read). Create/Update return 403 'Insufficient permissions. Required: write'; Delete returns 403 'Required: manage'. UI shows the server message in the red banner; no data change.

test_cases.title: Stock Management list loads with all columns
test_cases.preconditions: Logged in as admin; stock seeded.
steps: Navigate to /inventory/stock.
Verify a linear loading bar then the table with columns: Medicine, Location, Current Stock, PAR Level, Reorder Level, Stock Level, Category, Value, Status.
test_cases.expected_result: Rows render with medicine name+generic, location, numeric quantities, a stock-level progress bar, matrix category chip, ₹ value, and a status chip (Optimal/Low/Critical/Overstocked with prefix stripped).

test_cases.title: Filter stock by Location
test_cases.preconditions: At least 2 locations with stock.
steps: On /inventory/stock open 'Filter by Location' dropdown (populated from getLocations).
Select 'Central Store'.
Watch the Network call and table.
test_cases.expected_result: List re-fetches with location_id=<id>; only that location's stock shows. 'All Locations' clears the filter.

test_cases.title: Filter stock by Status
test_cases.preconditions: Stock exists across statuses.
steps: Select 'Filter by Status' = Low Stock.
Repeat for Critical, Optimal, Overstocked, and All Status.
test_cases.expected_result: Each selection re-fetches with status=<value> and only matching rows display; All Status clears it.

test_cases.title: Stock-level progress bar colour thresholds
test_cases.preconditions: Stock rows with varying current vs PAR.
steps: Inspect a row where current/PAR < 25% (bar red), one 25-50% (warning/amber), and one >=50% (green).
test_cases.expected_result: getStockLevel = min(current/PAR*100, 200); bar value capped at 100; colour error <25, warning <50, else success. Percentage label matches.

test_cases.title: Stock pagination control (client count caveat)
test_cases.preconditions: More than one page of stock would exist server-side.
steps: On /inventory/stock change Rows per page to 10.
Use the TablePagination next-page arrow.
Compare displayed count with actual data.
test_cases.expected_result: Changing rows-per-page resets page to 0 and re-fetches with the new per_page. NOTE/DEFECT-WATCH: pagination count is bound to the current page's array length (stockItems.length), not a server total, so the total-records label and last-page detection may be inaccurate. Log as a defect if next page returns empty unexpectedly.

test_cases.title: Stock empty state and API error banner
test_cases.preconditions: Filter combination that yields no rows; ability to force an error.
steps: Apply a location+status filter combination that returns no rows -> expect 'No stock items found'.
Force /inventory/stock to fail (block in DevTools) and refresh -> expect the error Alert.
test_cases.expected_result: Empty state row 'No stock items found'; on failure a dismissible red Alert 'Failed to load stock items' appears.

test_cases.title: Stock value currency formatting
test_cases.preconditions: Stock with non-zero total_value.
steps: Inspect the Value column for a high-value row.
test_cases.expected_result: Value shows as ₹ with en-IN grouping and exactly two decimals (e.g. ₹1,25,000.00).

test_cases.title: PO list loads with columns and status badges
test_cases.preconditions: At least one PO exists; logged in as admin.
steps: Navigate to /inventory/purchase-orders.
Verify columns: PO Number, Date, Supplier, Expected Delivery, Total Amount, Status, Actions.
Verify status badges use the correct colour/label mapping (Draft, Pending Approval, Approved, Sent to Supplier, Partially Received, Received, Cancelled).
test_cases.expected_result: POs list (20/page); dates formatted dd MMM yyyy; total amount with ₹ en-IN 2-dp; badge label/colour matches status.

test_cases.title: PO list status filter triggers server re-fetch
test_cases.preconditions: POs in various statuses.
steps: Open the 'Filter by status' Select and choose 'Approved'.
Watch the Network request.
Choose 'All Status'.
test_cases.expected_result: Selecting a status re-fetches with status=approved; only approved POs show. 'All Status' (value 'all') is treated as no filter.

test_cases.title: PO list search is client-side (current page only)
test_cases.preconditions: Multiple POs across pages.
steps: Type a PO number or supplier name in the search box.
Observe filtering.
test_cases.expected_result: Filtering happens in the browser over the already-loaded 20 records (po_number or supplier.supplier_name). DEFECT-WATCH: a PO on another page will not be found via search since search does not call the API.

test_cases.title: PO list empty state and 'Create Your First PO'
test_cases.preconditions: A status filter that returns zero POs, or no POs at all.
steps: Filter by a status that has no POs (e.g. cancelled when none cancelled).
Observe empty state.
test_cases.expected_result: Centered FileText icon, 'No purchase orders found', and a 'Create Your First PO' button routing to /inventory/purchase-orders/new.

test_cases.title: PO list pagination and skeleton loading
test_cases.preconditions: More than 20 POs exist.
steps: Open /inventory/purchase-orders and observe skeleton rows during load.
If pages > 1, click Next and Previous; verify disabled states at boundaries.
test_cases.expected_result: 5 skeleton bars show while loading; pagination shows 'Page X of N'; Previous disabled on page 1, Next disabled on last page (totalPages from response.pages).

test_cases.title: PO Wizard Step 1 required-field validation
test_cases.preconditions: Logged in as admin.
steps: Open /inventory/purchase-orders/new.
On Step 1 (Basic Information) click Next without selecting supplier, date, or location.
test_cases.expected_result: Inline errors: 'Supplier is required', 'Expected delivery date is required', 'Delivery location is required'; wizard stays on Step 1; date field border turns red.

test_cases.title: PO Wizard Step 1 - SupplierSelector search and selection
test_cases.preconditions: At least 2 suppliers, one preferred.
steps: Open the Supplier dropdown; type part of a supplier name in the in-dropdown search.
Select a supplier.
Confirm the details panel (Contact/Email/Lead Time/Payment) appears.
test_cases.expected_result: Suppliers load sorted preferred-first then by rating; search filters by supplier_name/company_name; selecting shows a 'Preferred' badge if applicable and the details card.

test_cases.title: PO Wizard Step 1 - Expected delivery date cannot be in the past
test_cases.preconditions: Logged in as admin; today is 2026-06-01.
steps: Open the Expected Delivery Date calendar popover.
Attempt to select a date before today.
test_cases.expected_result: Past dates are disabled (date < new Date()); only today or future dates can be picked.

test_cases.title: PO Wizard Step 1 - LocationSelector lists active locations with type badges
test_cases.preconditions: Active locations exist.
steps: Open the Delivery Location dropdown.
Select a location.
test_cases.expected_result: Locations load (is_active true); each shows a coloured type badge (Central Store/Pharmacy/etc.) and building/floor/room if present; selection shows the summary panel.

test_cases.title: PO Wizard Step 2 requires at least one item
test_cases.preconditions: Step 1 completed.
steps: Advance to Step 2 (Add Items) with no items added.
Click Next.
test_cases.expected_result: Error 'Please add at least one item to the purchase order'; the POItemsTable empty state shows; cannot proceed.

test_cases.title: PO Wizard Step 2 - POItemsTable medicine search and add
test_cases.preconditions: Medicines seeded.
steps: On Step 2 click 'Add Medicine' to reveal the search card.
Type at least 3 characters of a medicine name.
Click a result to add it as a row.
test_cases.expected_result: Search fires only when length > 2; results show name/generic/dosage_form/strength; clicking adds a row defaulting qty 1, unit_price 0, tax_percentage = medicine.gst_percentage; search card closes.

test_cases.title: PO Wizard Step 2 - duplicate medicine guard
test_cases.preconditions: One item already added.
steps: Add a medicine, then 'Add Medicine' again and select the same medicine.
test_cases.expected_result: Native alert 'This medicine is already added to the order'; no duplicate row created.

test_cases.title: PO Wizard Step 2 - per-item total and grand total math
test_cases.preconditions: At least one item added.
steps: Set Quantity 100, Unit Price 2.50, Discount 10%, Tax 12%.
Verify the row Total and the Grand Total.
test_cases.expected_result: Subtotal 250.00, discount 25.00, taxable 225.00, tax 27.00, line total ₹252.00; Grand Total sums all line totals (₹252.00 for one item).

test_cases.title: PO Wizard Step 2 - remove item
test_cases.preconditions: Two items added.
steps: Click the trash icon on one row.
test_cases.expected_result: That row is removed; grand total recalculates; remaining item stays.

test_cases.title: PO Wizard Step 2 - item quantity/price edge values
test_cases.preconditions: One item added.
steps: Set Quantity to 0, then to a negative number, then a non-numeric character.
Set Discount to 150% and Tax to -5%.
Observe totals and whether Next is allowed.
test_cases.expected_result: Inputs have min/max attributes (qty min 1, discount/tax 0-100) but the UI does not hard-block typing other values; totals compute from parsed floats (0 for blanks). Wizard allows advancing (only count>0 is checked). DEFECT-WATCH: a 0 or negative quantity will be rejected by the backend on submit (ordered_quantity Range min>0) returning 422.

test_cases.title: PO Wizard Step 3 review summary accuracy
test_cases.preconditions: Steps 1-2 completed with valid data.
steps: Advance to Step 3 (Review & Submit).
Verify Order Summary (supplier, expected delivery, location, total items) and the Items table and Financial Summary (subtotal/discount/tax/total).
test_cases.expected_result: All summary values match Step 1/2 inputs; financial totals equal the computed subtotal/discount/tax/total.

test_cases.title: PO Wizard submit creates PO and redirects to detail
test_cases.preconditions: Steps 1-2 valid; logged in as admin.
steps: On Step 3 click 'Create Purchase Order'.
Watch the request payload and the redirect.
test_cases.expected_result: POST sends supplier_id, po_date (today), expected_delivery_date (yyyy-MM-dd), delivery_location_id, notes, computed totals, status 'draft', and items[] each {medicine_id, ordered_quantity, unit_price, discount_percentage, tax_percentage, total_amount}. Returns 201; app navigates to /inventory/purchase-orders/{new id}.

test_cases.title: PO Wizard submit error surfaces server message
test_cases.preconditions: Force a failure (e.g. invalid supplier_id, or a 0-qty item per INV-043).
steps: Submit a PO that the backend rejects.
Observe the error region on Step 3.
test_cases.expected_result: Red box at bottom of Step 3 with the server message (or 'Failed to create purchase order'); no redirect; user stays on wizard.

test_cases.title: PO Wizard Back/Cancel navigation and step indicator
test_cases.preconditions: On any wizard step.
steps: Move forward then click Back; verify data persists.
Click Cancel (or 'Back to Purchase Orders').

test_cases.title: PO Detail view renders all sections

test_cases.title: PO Detail action buttons reflect status

Open a pending_approval PO -> expect 'Approve PO'.
Open an approved/sent/partial_received PO -> expect 'Receive Goods'.
Open a received and a cancelled PO -> expect only Print (no action button).
test_cases.expected_result: Action buttons are status-driven exactly as above; Print button always present.

test_cases.title: PO Detail approve flow

In the dialog optionally add approval notes; click 'Approve PO'.

test_cases.title: PO Detail submit-for-approval (draft -> pending)
test_cases.preconditions: A draft PO; logged in as admin.
steps: Open a draft PO; click 'Submit for Approval'.
Confirm in the dialog.

Verify the resulting status transition and whether /submit is ever invoked; log a defect if a draft PO is approved directly, skipping the submit step.

test_cases.title: PO Detail Receive Goods - full receipt with batch details
test_cases.preconditions: An approved PO with 1+ items; logged in as admin/data_entry (write).
steps: Open the PO; click 'Receive Goods'.
For each item enter Received Quantity, Batch Number, Manufacture Date, Expiry Date (expiry after mfg).
Click 'Confirm Receipt'.
test_cases.test_data: Batch BATCH-PCM-2401, Mfg 2026-01-10, Expiry 2028-01-10, Received = ordered qty
test_cases.expected_result: On success the PO status moves to received/partial_received and stock increases. DEFECT-WATCH: the dialog posts {items:[{item_id, received_quantity, batch_number, manufacture_date, expiry_date}]} but the backend GoodsReceiveSchema expects {received_items:[...]} with mrp optional. Verify whether receipt actually succeeds; a 422 'received_items required' indicates a payload-key mismatch defect.

test_cases.title: PO Receive Goods - missing batch detail blocked client-side
test_cases.preconditions: Receive Goods dialog open.
steps: Leave Batch Number (or a date) blank for one item.
Click 'Confirm Receipt'.
test_cases.expected_result: Native alert 'Please fill in all batch details for all items'; no API call sent. NOTE: the early return does not reset actionLoading, so the Confirm button may stay in 'Receiving...' state - log as a minor defect.

test_cases.title: PO Receive Goods - expiry before manufacture rejected
test_cases.preconditions: Receive Goods dialog open.
steps: Enter Manufacture Date 2027-01-01 and Expiry Date 2026-01-01 (expiry < mfg).
Note the date input min on expiry is set to manufacture_date.
Attempt to confirm.
test_cases.expected_result: The expiry field's min attribute discourages an earlier date; if forced, backend GoodsReceiveItemSchema.validate_dates returns 422 'Expiry date must be after manufacture date'.

test_cases.title: PO Receive Goods - partial receipt updates pending
test_cases.preconditions: An approved PO with an item ordered_quantity of e.g. 100.
steps: Open Receive Goods; set Received Quantity to 60 (less than ordered).
Enter valid batch details; confirm.
Reopen the PO detail.
test_cases.expected_result: If receipt succeeds, status becomes 'partial_received', the item shows Received 60 / Pending 40, and a 'Receive Goods' button remains for the balance.

test_cases.title: PO Detail not-found id

steps: Navigate to /inventory/purchase-orders/00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000.
test_cases.expected_result: GET returns 404; the page shows 'Purchase order not found' (po stays null after loading).

test_cases.title: data_entry role cannot approve a PO (403)

steps: Open a pending_approval PO; click 'Approve PO' and confirm.

test_cases.expected_result: POST .../approve returns 403 'Insufficient permissions. Required: approve'; an alert 'Failed to approve purchase order' shows; status unchanged.

test_cases.title: Dispensing records list default 'Today' filter and columns

test_cases.title: Dispensing list client-side search by patient/ABHA/dispenser
test_cases.preconditions: Multiple records loaded.
steps: Type a patient name, then an ABHA address, then a dispenser name in the search box.
test_cases.expected_result: Filtering is client-side over the current page only (patient.full_name, patient.abha_address, dispensed_by). DEFECT-WATCH: records on other pages won't match.

test_cases.title: Dispensing list empty state

steps: Set Date Range = Today on a day with no dispensing.
test_cases.expected_result: Centered FileText icon, 'No dispensing records found', and a 'Dispense Medicines' button to /inventory/dispense/new.

test_cases.title: Dispensing Wizard Step 1 - patient required

steps: Open /inventory/dispense/new.
On Step 1 click Next without selecting a patient.
test_cases.expected_result: Error 'Patient is required'; the search input border turns red; cannot advance.

test_cases.title: Dispensing Wizard Step 1 - PatientSelector recent + search
test_cases.preconditions: Recent patients exist; a searchable patient exists.
steps: On Step 1 observe 'Recent Patients' list (loaded on mount).
Type >2 chars in the search to search patients.
Select a patient; confirm the selected-patient card with a 'Change' link.
test_cases.test_data: Search: a known patient name (>=3 chars)
test_cases.expected_result: Recent patients load via patients API; search fires only when length > 2; selecting shows the patient card (name, ABHA, age from DOB, phone, location) and 'Change' clears it.
test_cases.api_reference: GET patients recent + GET patients search (patients API)

test_cases.title: Dispensing Wizard Step 2 - prescription path loads patient prescriptions
test_cases.preconditions: Selected patient has at least one OPD/Saranam prescription with pending items.
steps: Advance to Step 2; keep the 'From Prescription' tab.
Verify prescriptions render with source badge (OPD/SARANAM_VISIT), status, prescriber, date and medication list with Qty/Dispensed/Pending.
Click a prescription card to select it.
test_cases.expected_result: GET prescriptions returns the list; selecting maps medications into items (qty defaults to pending_quantity); the card highlights with 'Selected for Dispensing'.

test_cases.title: Dispensing Wizard Step 2 - prescription empty state
test_cases.preconditions: Selected patient has NO prescriptions.
steps: Select a patient with no prescriptions and advance to Step 2 'From Prescription'.
test_cases.expected_result: PrescriptionSelector shows 'No active prescriptions found / This patient has no pending prescriptions to dispense'.

test_cases.title: Dispensing Wizard Step 2 - Direct Dispense (QuickDispenseSelector)
test_cases.preconditions: Medicines seeded.
steps: On Step 2 switch to the 'Direct Dispense' tab.
Click 'Add Medicine', search (>2 chars), and add a medicine.
Set a quantity and enter instructions.
test_cases.test_data: Medicine Paracetamol, Qty 5, Instructions '1-0-1 x 5 days'
test_cases.expected_result: Search uses medicines/search; adding sets dispense_type 'direct' and an item with qty 1 default; a yellow Direct Dispensing warning banner shows; duplicate add is blocked with an alert.

test_cases.title: Dispensing Wizard Step 2 requires at least one item
test_cases.preconditions: On Step 2 with no prescription selected and no direct items.
steps: Click Next without selecting a prescription or adding direct items.
test_cases.expected_result: Error 'Please select a prescription or add medicines'; cannot advance.

test_cases.title: Dispensing Wizard Step 3 - BatchSelector FEFO auto-selection
test_cases.preconditions: Selected medicine has multiple available batches with different expiry dates.
steps: Advance to Step 3.
For each medicine confirm the Batch Selection card shows Required/Available/Selected and a batches table sorted by earliest expiry (FEFO checkbox on by default).
Verify the first batch is tagged 'Recommended' and auto-selection fills the required quantity.
test_cases.test_data: Medicine with batches expiring on different dates
test_cases.expected_result: Batches load (response.data.batches); FEFO sorts by expiry ascending; auto-select allocates from earliest-expiry batches until required qty met; expiry badges colour-coded (expired/<=30/<=90/healthy); expired rows are disabled and dimmed.

test_cases.title: Dispensing Wizard Step 3 - FIFO toggle re-sorts batches
test_cases.preconditions: Batches with differing manufacture dates.
steps: On Step 3 uncheck 'Use FEFO (First Expiry, First Out)'.
Click 'Auto-Select FIFO'.
test_cases.expected_result: Batches re-sort by manufacture_date ascending; auto-select label changes to 'Auto-Select FIFO' and allocates from oldest-manufactured batches first.

test_cases.title: Dispensing Wizard Step 3 - insufficient stock warning blocks advance
test_cases.preconditions: Required quantity exceeds total available across batches.
steps: Set/select a medicine quantity greater than the sum of available batch quantities.
Observe the Stock Summary and try Next.
test_cases.expected_result: Red 'Insufficient Stock - Only 120 units available. 380 units short.' banner; Available shown in red; validateStep3 fails (total selected < required) -> error 'Please select batches for all medicines' and the wizard will not advance.

test_cases.title: Dispensing Wizard Step 3 - per-batch quantity cannot exceed batch availability
test_cases.preconditions: A batch with available_quantity e.g. 50.
steps: In the Dispense Qty input for that batch type 999.
test_cases.expected_result: Entered value is clamped to the batch available_quantity (Math.min). Over-selection across batches beyond Required shows the orange 'Over-Selected' banner.

test_cases.title: Dispensing Wizard Step 4 review and confirm dispense
test_cases.preconditions: Steps 1-3 valid; logged in as admin/data_entry (dispense permission).
steps: On Step 4 review Patient, Prescription (if any), Medicines with selected batches and dispense type.
Click 'Confirm & Dispense'.
Watch the payload and the redirect.
test_cases.expected_result: On success app redirects to /inventory/dispensing/{record id}. DEFECT-WATCH: the wizard posts {patient_id, prescription_id, dispense_type, notes, items:[{medicine_id, quantity, instructions, batches:[...]}]} but DispenseCreateSchema expects a single-medicine body {patient_id, medicine_id, dispensed_quantity, dispensed_from_location, batch_id}. A 422 'Validation error' (missing medicine_id/dispensed_quantity/dispensed_from_location) indicates a payload-shape mismatch defect - verify whether dispensing actually persists.

test_cases.title: Dispensing Wizard submit error surfaces server message
test_cases.preconditions: Force a backend rejection on dispense.
steps: Confirm & Dispense with a payload the backend rejects.
Observe Step 4.
test_cases.expected_result: Red box at bottom of Step 4 shows the server message or 'Failed to dispense medicines'; no redirect.

test_cases.title: Dispensing Dashboard KPIs and recent records
test_cases.preconditions: Some dispensing activity today; logged in as admin.
steps: Navigate to /inventory/dispense/dashboard.
Verify the 4 stat cards (Today's Dispensing, Patients Served, Total Items, Pending Returns) and the Recent Dispensing Records table (max 5 rows).
test_cases.expected_result: KPIs come from analytics/kpis (today_dispensing, patients_served_today, total_items_today, pending_returns; default 0 if absent); recent records from the dispensing list; clicking a recent row opens its detail.

test_cases.title: Dispensing Dashboard quick actions and empty state

steps: On /inventory/dispense/dashboard with no records, verify the empty state and the three Quick Action buttons.
Click 'New Dispensing', 'View All Records', 'Low Stock Alerts'.
test_cases.expected_result: Empty state 'No dispensing records yet'; Quick Actions route to /inventory/dispense/new, /inventory/dispense, /inventory/stock respectively.

test_cases.title: Dispensing Detail view renders patient/prescription/items
test_cases.preconditions: A valid dispensing record id.
steps: Open /inventory/dispensing/{id}.
Verify Patient Information, Prescription Details (if any), Dispensing Details, and the Dispensed Medicines table (Medicine, Batch, Expiry, Dispensed Qty, Returned Qty, Instructions, Actions).
test_cases.expected_result: Record loads via GET; all cards populated; batch number and expiry shown per item; type badge in header.

test_cases.title: Dispensing Detail - return medicine flow
test_cases.preconditions: A record with a returnable item (dispensed_quantity > returned_quantity); dispense permission.
steps: Click 'Return' on a returnable item row.
In the dialog set a return quantity and a reason.
Click 'Confirm Return'.
test_cases.expected_result: POST .../return returns 200; dialog closes; record re-fetched; the item's Returned Qty badge updates. The quantity input is capped at (dispensed - already returned).

test_cases.title: Dispensing Detail - return validation (reason and qty)
test_cases.preconditions: Return dialog open.
steps: Clear the reason and click Confirm Return.
Set return quantity to 0 and click Confirm Return.
test_cases.expected_result: Alert 'Please provide a reason for return' when reason empty; alert 'Return quantity must be greater than 0' when qty <= 0; no API call. NOTE: these early returns do not reset actionLoading - watch for a stuck 'Processing...' button (minor defect).

test_cases.title: Dispensing Detail - not-found id

test_cases.expected_result: GET returns 404; the page shows 'Dispensing record not found'.

test_cases.title: Alerts list loads with status tabs and counts
test_cases.preconditions: Active alerts exist; logged in as admin.
steps: Navigate to /inventory/alerts.
Confirm the default tab is 'Active' and the tabs (Active/Acknowledged/Resolved/All Alerts) with count badges.
Verify each AlertCard shows type label, severity badge, message, medicine/batch/location and timestamps.
test_cases.expected_result: Active tab loads alerts with acknowledged=false & resolved=false; cards render correctly; the Active tab shows a red count badge when count > 0.

test_cases.title: Alerts type and severity filters
test_cases.preconditions: Alerts of multiple types/severities.
steps: Set Type filter = Low Stock, then Out of Stock, Near Expiry, Expired.
Set Severity = Critical, High, Medium, Low.
Watch the requests.
test_cases.expected_result: Type sends alert_type=<value>; severity sends severity=<value>; 'All Types'/'All Severities' clear them; list updates accordingly.

test_cases.title: Acknowledge a single alert
test_cases.preconditions: An active (unacknowledged) alert exists; write permission.
steps: On an active AlertCard click 'Acknowledge'.
Observe the card and list.
test_cases.expected_result: POST .../acknowledge returns 200; list re-fetches; the alert now shows an 'Acknowledged' badge and a 'Mark Resolved' button.

test_cases.title: Resolve an acknowledged alert
test_cases.preconditions: An acknowledged (not resolved) alert exists.
steps: On the Acknowledged tab click 'Mark Resolved' on a card.
Observe the list.
test_cases.test_data: Resolution note auto-sent: 'Resolved from alerts list'
test_cases.expected_result: POST .../resolve returns 200 with body {resolution_notes:'Resolved from alerts list'}; list refreshes and the alert moves to Resolved.

test_cases.title: Bulk Acknowledge All on Active tab
test_cases.preconditions: Several active alerts on the current page.
steps: On the Active tab click 'Acknowledge All (N)'.
Confirm the browser prompt.
Observe results.
test_cases.expected_result: After confirming, an acknowledge POST fires for each currently-loaded unacknowledged alert sequentially; list refreshes with those alerts acknowledged. The button only appears on the Active tab when count.active > 0.

test_cases.title: Alerts tab counts derived from current page only
test_cases.preconditions: More than one page of alerts.
steps: Note the count badges on tabs versus the actual total across pages.
test_cases.expected_result: DEFECT-WATCH: getAlertCounts is computed from the loaded alerts array (current page), not a server aggregate; counts may understate totals when paginated. Log as a defect/enhancement.

test_cases.title: Alerts list empty states per tab

steps: Switch to a tab (e.g. Resolved) with no alerts.
test_cases.expected_result: Bell icon empty card with a context message (e.g. 'No active alerts - your inventory is in good shape!' / 'No resolved alerts').

test_cases.title: AlertCard View Medicine / View Batch links

steps: Click 'View Medicine' on an alert; then 'View Batch' if present.
test_cases.expected_result: Navigates to /inventory/medicines/{medicine_id} and /inventory/batches/{batch_id}. DEFECT-WATCH: there are no App.jsx routes for /inventory/medicines/:id or /inventory/batches/:id, so these likely land on a not-found / blank route - log as a broken-link defect.

test_cases.title: Alerts Dashboard summary stats and breakdown
test_cases.preconditions: Active alerts exist; logged in as admin.
steps: Navigate to /inventory/alerts/dashboard.
Verify the 4 summary cards (Total Active, Critical, Out of Stock, Near Expiry), the 'Alerts by Type' and 'Alerts by Severity' breakdowns, and the Critical Alerts list.
test_cases.expected_result: Stats are computed from two GET /alerts calls (critical+unresolved, and all unresolved); breakdown counts match; Critical Alerts shows up to 3 AlertCards with acknowledge/resolve actions.

test_cases.title: Alerts Dashboard stat-card and quick-action navigation
test_cases.preconditions: Logged in as admin.
steps: Click each summary card (Total Active/Critical/Out of Stock/Near Expiry).
Click the quick actions (Check Stock Levels, Create Purchase Order, Expiring Batches) and 'View All Alerts'.
test_cases.expected_result: Summary cards route to /inventory/alerts with query params (?status=active, ?severity=critical, ?type=out_of_stock, ?type=near_expiry). NOTE: AlertsList does not read these query params (it manages its own filter state), so the filter may not pre-apply - log as a minor defect. Quick actions route to /inventory/stock, /inventory/purchase-orders/new and /inventory/batches?expiring=soon (the last has no matching route).

test_cases.title: Acknowledge failure handled gracefully

steps: Force an acknowledge call to fail.
Observe behaviour.
test_cases.expected_result: Backend returns 404 if not found; UI shows alert 'Failed to acknowledge alert' and the list is unchanged.

test_cases.title: Provider Stock page lists provider locations with summary

steps: Navigate to /inventory/provider-stock.
Verify each ProviderCard shows provider name, total items and total value (Rs. en-IN), plus Assign (+) and Return (-) actions and an expand chevron.
test_cases.expected_result: Providers load from GET /provider-stock/locations; cards render with summary; Refresh and 'Setup New Provider' buttons present in the header.

test_cases.title: Provider Stock empty state
test_cases.preconditions: No provider stock locations.
steps: Open /inventory/provider-stock with no providers configured.
test_cases.expected_result: Empty card with Users icon, 'No Provider Stock Locations', and a 'Setup First Provider' button.

test_cases.title: Expand provider to view assigned stock
test_cases.preconditions: A provider with assigned stock.
steps: Click a ProviderCard to expand it.
Verify the stock table (Medicine, Qty, Value, Batch, Expiry) or a 'No stock assigned yet' empty state.
test_cases.expected_result: On first expand, GET /provider-stock/{provider_id} loads the items; table shows them; subsequent collapse/expand does not re-fetch.

test_cases.title: Setup New Provider
test_cases.preconditions: A valid provider UUID with no stock location yet; write permission.
steps: Click 'Setup New Provider'.
Enter the provider ID.
Click Setup.
test_cases.test_data: Provider ID: a valid provider UUID
test_cases.expected_result: POST /provider-stock/{id}/setup returns 200 with the new location; modal closes; the provider list refreshes and includes the new provider.

test_cases.title: Setup New Provider - invalid id error
test_cases.preconditions: Setup modal open.
steps: Enter an invalid/non-existent provider id.
Click Setup.
test_cases.expected_result: Backend returns 400 with {error:...}; UI shows alert with the server error message; modal stays open; no provider added.

test_cases.title: Assign stock to provider
test_cases.preconditions: A provider exists; source location has stock; medicines searchable.
steps: On a ProviderCard click the + (Assign Stock) action.
Search and pick a medicine, choose a Source Location, enter a quantity.
Click 'Assign Stock'.
test_cases.expected_result: On success the modal closes and the provider card/stock refreshes. DEFECT-WATCH: the modal posts {medicine_id, quantity, source_location_id} but the backend assign route reads from_location_id (data['from_location_id']) -> a KeyError yields 400 with the missing-key error. Verify whether assignment actually persists; a 400 indicates a field-name mismatch defect.

test_cases.title: Assign stock - location list excludes provider bags; medicine search min length
test_cases.preconditions: Assign modal open.
steps: Open the Source Location dropdown and confirm provider_bag-type locations are excluded.
Type 1 char in medicine search (no results), then >=2 chars (results appear after ~300ms debounce).
test_cases.expected_result: Locations filtered to exclude location_type 'provider_bag'; medicine search only runs at length >= 2 with a 300ms debounce; Assign button disabled until medicine, quantity and source location are all set.

test_cases.title: Return stock from provider with max-quantity guard
test_cases.preconditions: A provider with assigned stock.
steps: On a ProviderCard click the - (Return Stock) action.
Select a medicine from the provider's stock, choose a Destination Location.
Enter a quantity greater than available; then a valid quantity; click 'Return Stock'.
test_cases.expected_result: Entering more than available shows 'Cannot exceed available quantity (10)' and disables the Return button. A valid return submits. DEFECT-WATCH: the modal posts {medicine_id, quantity, destination_location_id} but the backend return route reads to_location_id -> a 400 KeyError indicates a field-name mismatch defect; verify return actually persists.

test_cases.title: Provider stock transfer reflected in both source and provider (data integrity)
test_cases.preconditions: Assign succeeds (or use the working path); note source-location stock before.
steps: Record the source location's current_stock for a medicine (via /inventory/stock).
Assign N units to a provider.
Re-check the source location stock and the provider's stock.
test_cases.expected_result: Source location current_stock decreases by 20; provider stock increases by 20; a return reverses it. Totals must reconcile (no stock created or lost).

test_cases.title: Receiving a PO increases stock on hand
test_cases.preconditions: An approved PO; note the delivery location's stock for the PO medicines.
steps: Record current_stock for a PO line medicine at the delivery location.
Receive the PO fully with valid batch details.
Re-check the stock at that location and the new batch.
test_cases.expected_result: After a successful receipt, stock at the location increases by the received quantity, a new batch record exists with the entered batch number/expiry, and the PO status reflects received/partial_received.

test_cases.title: Dispensing reduces stock on hand and batch quantity
test_cases.preconditions: A medicine with available batch stock; dispense permission.

Dispense a known quantity from that batch.
Re-check stock and batch available_quantity.
test_cases.expected_result: On a successful dispense, the location stock and the batch available_quantity each drop by the dispensed quantity; a dispensing record is created. (If dispense fails due to the payload mismatch in INV-072, log that defect and verify no partial stock change occurred.)

test_cases.title: Returning dispensed medicine restores stock
test_cases.preconditions: A dispensing record with a returnable item.
steps: Note the batch/location stock for the dispensed medicine.
Return part of the dispensed quantity with a reason.
Re-check stock and the record's returned quantity.
test_cases.expected_result: Returned quantity is recorded on the item, and stock for that batch/location increases by the returned amount (return-to-stock), preserving totals.

Open /inventory/alerts and the Alerts Dashboard.

Call again with medicine_id+location_id but quantity=0 or negative.
Call with all valid params and a positive quantity.

As admin POST with a missing medicine_id/location_id.
As admin POST a valid body.
test_cases.expected_result: data_entry -> 403 'Required: manage'; missing fields -> 422 validation; valid -> 200 'Stock updated successfully' with the stock object. Negative quantity -> 422 (Range min 0).

test_cases.title: Stock transfer between locations

steps: POST /inventory/stock/transfer with valid from/to/medicine/quantity.
POST with a quantity exceeding source stock.
test_cases.expected_result: Valid transfer -> 201 'Stock transferred successfully' with a movement; source decreases and destination increases. Over-stock transfer -> 400 with the service ValueError message; no change.

test_cases.title: per_page cap enforced on list endpoints

Inspect the returned per_page.

In DevTools set localStorage access_token to an invalid value and remove refresh_token.
Trigger a request (e.g. Refresh or change page).
test_cases.expected_result: The first 401 attempts a token refresh; with no/invalid refresh_token the refresh fails, tokens+user are cleared from localStorage and the app redirects to /login.

test_cases.title: Direct access to inventory routes without login redirects to login
test_cases.preconditions: Not logged in (no token).
steps: In a fresh/incognito session navigate directly to /inventory, /inventory/dispense/new, /inventory/purchase-orders/new and /inventory/provider-stock.
test_cases.expected_result: All inventory routes are protected; an unauthenticated user is redirected to /login (no inventory data is rendered).

test_cases.title: Token with deleted/unknown user returns 401 User not found
test_cases.preconditions: A technically valid JWT whose user id no longer exists (coordinate with backend).
steps: Use the orphaned token to call any inventory endpoint (e.g. GET /inventory/medicines).
test_cases.test_data: JWT for a non-existent user id
test_cases.expected_result: Backend role_required returns 401 {'message':'User not found'}; the client treats it as a 401 and follows the refresh/redirect path.

test_cases.title: Schedule X / narcotic medicine create and display
test_cases.preconditions: Logged in as admin.
steps: Create a medicine with Drug Schedule X (e.g. Morphine 10mg Injection).
Verify it saves and lists correctly.
test_cases.expected_result: drug_class 'X' is accepted (OneOf G/H/H1/X); the medicine is created and shown; form badge shows Injection.

test_cases.title: Very large dispense quantity handling
test_cases.preconditions: A medicine with limited stock.
steps: In the Direct Dispense tab set an item quantity to a very large number (e.g. 1000000).
Proceed to batch selection.
test_cases.expected_result: Batch selector shows Available < Required with the red insufficient-stock banner; the wizard cannot advance past Step 3 because batches cannot cover the requirement.

test_cases.title: Expired batch cannot be selected for dispensing
test_cases.preconditions: The selected medicine has at least one expired batch and one valid batch.
steps: On Step 3 locate the expired batch row.
Attempt to enter a Dispense Qty in the expired batch's input.
test_cases.expected_result: The expired batch row is dimmed (opacity-50) and its Dispense Qty input is disabled; expiry badge shows 'Expired'; auto-select skips it in practice because FEFO orders it first but it cannot be edited - verify allocation still favours valid batches.

test_cases.title: Cancel a purchase order with reason (API)
test_cases.preconditions: A draft/approved PO; approve permission.
steps: As admin POST /inventory/purchase-orders/{id}/cancel with body {reason:'Supplier unavailable'}.
As data_entry attempt the same cancel.
test_cases.expected_result: admin -> 200 'Purchase order cancelled' and status becomes Cancelled; data_entry -> 403 'Required: approve'. NOTE: the PO Detail UI has no Cancel button, so this is API-level verification only.

test_cases.title: Receive Goods - received quantity exceeding ordered/pending
test_cases.preconditions: An approved PO line ordered_quantity 100.
steps: In the Receive Goods dialog set Received Quantity to 500 (more than ordered).
Enter valid batch details and confirm.
test_cases.expected_result: Schema-wise received_quantity > 0 is valid; business rule expectation is that the service rejects over-receipt with a 400 ValueError. Verify the backend response and that stock is not over-credited; log a defect if over-receipt silently succeeds.

test_cases.title: GST percentage boundary values
test_cases.preconditions: Logged in as admin.
steps: Create a medicine with GST 0, then 100 (valid bounds), then 101 (invalid).
test_cases.expected_result: GST 0 and 100 accepted (Range 0-100); GST 101 -> 422 validation error; record not saved for the invalid value.

test_cases.title: Selectors handle empty backing data without crashing
test_cases.preconditions: Environment with zero suppliers / zero locations (or block the calls).
steps: Open the PO Wizard Step 1 with no suppliers and no locations available.
Open the Supplier and Location dropdowns.
test_cases.expected_result: SupplierSelector shows 'No suppliers found'; LocationSelector shows 'No locations found'; no JS error; the wizard still validates 'required' on Next.

test_cases.title: BatchSelector with no batches for medicine
test_cases.preconditions: A medicine with zero available batches selected for dispensing.
steps: On Step 3 view a medicine that has no batches.
test_cases.expected_result: BatchSelector shows the Package icon with 'No batches available for this medicine'; Available = 0; insufficient-stock banner shows; wizard cannot proceed.

test_cases.title: Patient prescriptions endpoint requires UUID patient id
test_cases.preconditions: Valid token.
steps: Call GET /inventory/prescriptions/patient/not-a-uuid.
Call GET /inventory/prescriptions/patient/{valid-uuid}.
test_cases.expected_result: Non-UUID path does not match the <uuid:patient_id> converter and returns 404 (route not matched); a valid UUID returns {prescriptions, total} aggregating OPD + Saranam plan-of-care, or an empty list if none.
